title: Kenworth K220 FUPS Compliant custom built polished high tensile Aluminium Bullbar # 105
description: Kenworth K220 high tensile aluminium FUPS and Radar (AEB) compliant polished Bullbar, Disibio style channel with vents to cool oil cooler & spotlight mounts allow maximum clearance from back of light to cab. 76mm pipes std. option 88mm pipe. main pipes are one piece passing through drilled heavy duty uprights. Heavy duty tow pin in steel backing plate.
